main_text.p: omnes dies noftri praetereunt in indigna-tione tua, confumimus annos noftros ve-lut fermonem?

Respondeo: Nequaquam eade est pio-rum & reproborum fors. Illis enim ob peccati reliquias, ferula paterna, & ignarius, quem unicuique dedit Deus, feredus est, quum fit paterni amoris character: his autem poenae temporales æternorum tormētorum anteambulones, subeundę fant, siue eae accelerentur siue differantur.

Sæpe autem demiratus sum, quum tota militantem Ecclesiam, tot ærumnis & calamitatibus obnoxiam esse, omnes intelli-gamus, posse nobis vel in mentem venire delicatum noftrę tranquillitatis & iucundæ vitæ,desiderium?

Sæpe & illud demiror, non hoc nobis in mentem venire, exules nos esse, & ad pa-triam contendere: eoq; nomine exilij in-commoda Christiano animo nobis esse sustinenda & superanda? Quid enim? Si hic perinde tum in patria, suauiter nos haberi volumus, cur de patria gloriamur?
Sed omissis illis, intueamur exempla eo-rum, qui hoc tempore calicem iræ Dei bibunt.
Sunt, qui belli pacisq; commoda, idolo-latriae, quam exercent & propugnant, acce

page.notes: Catchword "pta" is the start of the next page's word "accepta", which is split at the line end; no hyphen is printed after "acce", so none is added. "eft" is transcribed as "est" and "fuauiter"/"fustinenda" as "suauiter"/"sustinenda" under the long-s rule. "feredus" is uncertain (the initial letter may be a long s, so "heredus" is possible); written as printed. "velin" is printed without a space and is kept so. Possible printing error: "sustinenda" may be intended; the printed form reads "fuftinenda". No reference marks or notes in the margins.
